sources.snippet: This makes LayoutLMv3 the first multimodal pre-trained Document AI model without CNNs for image embeddings, which significantly saves parameters and gets rid of region annotations. The simple unified architecture and objectives make LayoutLMv3 a general-purpose pre-trained model for both text-centric tasks and image-centric Document AI tasks.

sources.snippet: LayoutLMv3 (Document Foundation Model) Self-supervised pre-training techniques have achieved remarkable progress in Document AI. Most multimodal pre-trained models use a masked language modeling objective to learn bidirectional representations on the text modality, but they differ in pre-training objectives for the image modality.
